author: Laszlo Krasznaorkai
comments: Just picked up because it was his only one at the store. Needed to get used to the writing style but then really liked it. Enjoyed the German elements and atmosphere

author: Halldór Laxness
comments: Recommend by Stefan. I found the writing very rich once I got in to it. Slow moving and a bit tough to get in to but very enjoyable. Sometimes funny and also tragic, feels like a universal story about trying to make your own way.

author: Alison Espach
comments: I liked the beginning and set up but it became a bit cliche and I was disappointed that it went to the romantic/ happy ending. Easy read.

author: Christian Kracht
comments: Had the author recommended to me and have noticed it because of the great cover. I really liked the tone and composition. International booker longlist

author: Nana Kwame Adjei-Brenyah
comments: Recommended by Hilary, Adam, Jenna. Powerful and thought provoking, intense.

author: Deborah Levy
comments: I love Deborah Levy’s writing but this didn’t really work for me. It felt a bit young/immature. Also maybe just didn’t read it at the right time/mood.

author: Vincenzo Latronico
comments: I liked it and it was interesting to see and relate to Berlin and the expat experience. He doesn’t like his characters much and it was a bit harsh

author: Maggie Nelson
comments: I blew through it and really liked her writing style. Her observations about motherhood and love made me think about them in new and different ways, and also feel something

author: Natalia Ginzburg
comments: Recommended by Sara. Liked the writing, pace and atmosphere

author: Cormac McCarthy
comments: Dad recommended. The writing and atmosphere is beautiful. The story okay, I liked but didn’t completely connect. I liked blood meridian more

author: David Grann
comments: A really great adventure story. Engrossing and fast paced with an ethical consciousness but not too heavy emphasis

author: Annie Ernaux
comments: Very short, evocative.

author: Kate Chopin
comments: Enjoyed it! Heard about years ago from Rachel/ashley. Beautifully written, feminist

author: Helen Macdonald
comments: Was fine but I didn’t connect with it

author: Lisa Ridzen
comments: Hilary told me about it. Very moving, I stopped and returned multiple times because too emotional. The main character is not very sympathetic but really well written and you feel with him

author: Lili Anolik
comments: Stefan picked it up for me randomly. Loved and tore through it. In the opening and closing the writer made herself a bit too central for my taste

author: Lily King
comments: Stefan picked it up. University in to life love story, quick and easy and enjoyable

author: Belle Burden
comments: It was fine I read it very fast but I didn’t like her very much and didn’t really connect. She's a bit too privileged

author: Shirley Hazzard
comments: An author I liked said she loves this book. Nice atmosphere and subtle emotion

author: Theodor Fontane
comments: Stefan recommended. About morals and life, youth. Really enjoyed

author: Robin Wall Kimmerer
comments: A bit dry and a bit preachy but overall enjoyed it. Makes you want to appreciate and be in nature

author: Henry Miller
comments: It was fine but not my style very masculine and a bit dated, also not the summer/ nature feeling I was looking for in a Greek travelogue

author: L.P. Hartley
comments: The past is a foreign country. Liked it okay but didn’t really connect. Liked the child’s perspective
